title: A sound clip on the timeline wears the background the user picks between the two mocks
goal: A sound clip on the timeline has a flat green background, as the main editing mock draws it. The audio mock draws the same lane in the neutral panel colour with a thin edge in the lane's own colour, so the sound reads as the coloured shape. Ask which the user wants, then draw that.
notes: Found auditing a-sound-lane-is-as-tall-as-the-mock-s-and-its-wa (2026-10-07). App: ClipPiecesBar.fill returns kind.fill, VideoKit ClipKind.audio fill is the DS .clip.aud gradient #26463A to #1C3A30 (photonz-ds.css:927, used by video.html). video-audio.html ~44 .lane.alane background var(--panel-2) with a clip rect fill rgba(255,255,255,.03) stroke col at .35 (~500), and .cliptag (~65, left 8 top 6, 9px 640 white on black .4). The name half of this was settled in the same task: a sound on its own track now wears the mock's .cliptag (ClipPiecesBar.soundTag), and a linked sound carries no words on purpose. Searched: cliptag, sound clip name, lane ground, clip.aud (--all); nothing covered it.
acceptance: A decision card shows both backgrounds side by side on the talk sample and the music track, in light and dark, and the user picks one
The sound clip wears the picked background, with the waveform, level line and name still legible over it in light and dark
A walk at Next defaults photographs it beside video-audio.html's lanes
